scripts.render: podman build -q -t ccs-render -f deploy/Containerfile.render deploy >/dev/null && mkdir -p .render-cache && podman run --rm --network=none -v "$PWD":/w:ro,z -v "$PWD/dist":/w/dist:z -v "$PWD/.render-cache":/w/.render-cache:z -w /w ccs-render python3 -B deploy/render/render.py example-data dist/templates dist .render-cache
scripts.test: podman build -q -t ccs-render -f deploy/Containerfile.render deploy >/dev/null && podman build -q -t ccs-tests tests >/dev/null && podman run --rm --network=none -v "$PWD":/w:ro,z -w /w ccs-tests sh -c 'black -q --check deploy tests && pydocstyle --convention=pep257 --add-ignore=D100,D101,D102,D103,D105,D107 deploy tests && shellcheck -x -P deploy deploy/*.sh deploy/*/*.sh && python3 -B -m pytest -q tests'
scripts.preview: pnpm build && pnpm render && podman run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:4321:4321 -v "$PWD":/w:ro,z -w /w ccs-render python3 -B deploy/web/preview.py
